description: Design, build, or refactor websites in the Command Deck language, derived from the public-facing EDCOMMANDER design system. Use for make density feel controlled: persistent context, docked work surfaces, narrow status language, and action hierarchy that survives pressure. Includes narrative guidance, design tokens, page structure, a responsive static starter, safe scaffolding, and publication checks. Adapt the system to the user's brand instead of cloning names, logos, copy, or proprietary content.
